tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Canvas, the open document's sheet, the active tab, cards and their diagram thumbnails, menus, floating islands and toasts. Also the label on `ink` fills (primary button, ink tile, tooltip).

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Window frame: sidebar, tab strip and rail. Secondary buttons and chips on `surface`; the segmented-control track; a folder card's well.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, buttons and menu items; the path chip on the Continue card.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected tree row, current nav item, pressed toggle or open menu button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside islands, menus and toolbars.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Separators between inactive tabs.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The sidebar's and AI panel's resize edge on hover; the dashed edge of an open folder's sub-frame on the library canvas.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Canvas dot grid: 1px dots on a 20px pitch.

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Fills of the small shape previews in the tool strip.

tokens.name: dash
tokens.usage: Lifelines and other dashed guides drawn on the canvas; the "/" between the steps of a path.

tokens.name: frame-dash
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of Studio frames and groups and of project frames on the library canvas; the Mono swatch ring.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `frame`, `hover` and `selected`; connector lines; the primary button and focus ring.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Toolbar, row and menu icons on `surface` and `frame`; a toast's text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on `surface` and `frame` (4.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the `hover` and `selected` tints.

tokens.name: ink-surface
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the ink 'Blank diagram' tile; their text is `surface`.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ink-surface` (a tooltip's shortcut hint).

tokens.name: on-ink-line
tokens.usage: Dividers drawn on `ink-surface`.

tokens.name: on-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary labels on `ink-surface`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window under a dialog (Settings); the dialog itself is `surface` with `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete actions and error text on `surface` and `frame`. The error toast sits on light `tile-rose` in both themes, so its icon uses `deep-rose`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success marks, such as the check by a found CLI in the AI panel.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: glyph-folder
tokens.usage: The folder glyph (folder, folder-open) wherever it stands for a folder: tree, Move to… picker, chips, folder card wells, sub-frame heads. Duotone: this line over `glyph-folder-soft`.

tokens.name: glyph-folder-soft
tokens.usage: The folder glyph's fill, a light tint of `glyph-folder`.

tokens.name: glyph-diagram
tokens.usage: The diagram glyph (workflow) wherever it stands for a diagram: tree, picker chip, drag chip. Duotone: this line over `glyph-diagram-soft` squares.

tokens.name: glyph-diagram-soft
tokens.usage: The diagram glyph's square fills, a light tint of `glyph-diagram`.

tokens.name: badge-blue

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Unused in the chrome: no Home view has a big title (the path in its header row names it).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Frame and card titles on the library canvas, in board units (they scale with the camera).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Card titles, the active tab, the selected row.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Sidebar rows: the tree, Home and Recent, Open file…, and the Move to… picker. 600 when selected.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Buttons, menu items, tabs and chat text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under titles, counts, tooltips and shortcut hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, set in uppercase; chips.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The smallest labels: under icons, inside thumbnails.

styles.name: line-label
styles.usage: A connector's label, on the canvas colour.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Between tabs and between segment items; 1px hairlines between tree rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to chevron; padding inside islands and menus.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label in small controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in rows and buttons; the sidebar's side padding; toolbar row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Island inset from the canvas edges; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; gaps between cards and between chat messages.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Canvas dot pitch; traffic-light inset; between a header and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a Home view.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Minimum side padding of a Home view.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The chrome band; the edit bar.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Studio tiles (diagram only).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: 24px controls: strip buttons, segment items, tree rows; 4px for 18-20px buttons.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: 28-32px buttons, nav rows, menu items, island buttons, preview wells.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: A tab's top corners and fillets; the sheet's corner under the tabs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-island
tokens.usage: Floating islands, menus, the chat composer; segmented tracks use 7px.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The peeking sidebar and other large floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Hint pills and round chips.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Floating islands (toolbars, zoom, edit bar), resting cards and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: A hovered card.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, flyouts and tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Panels that float over content: the peeking sidebar and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The active segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: chrome-height
tokens.usage: The top band: the sidebar's top row and the tab strip.

tokens.name: traffic-light-inset
tokens.usage: Left edge of the first traffic light from the window edge.

tokens.name: traffic-light-center
tokens.usage: Vertical centre shared by the lights, the band's buttons and tab labels.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The library sidebar's default width (232 + 2 x 8 padding).

tokens.name: sidebar-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest the sidebar resizes to; dragging past it hides the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-max
tokens.usage: Widest the sidebar resizes to.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: A tab: 8px from the top of the strip, bottom flush with it.

tokens.name: tab-width
tokens.usage: A document tab.

tokens.name: tab-pinned-width
tokens.usage: The pinned Library tab (icon only: the app glyph).

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: The editor's toolbar row under the tab strip.

tokens.name: ai-panel-width
tokens.usage: The docked AI panel.

tokens.name: island-inset
tokens.usage: Floating islands sit this far from the canvas edges.

tokens.name: island-height
tokens.usage: The selection edit bar and the shape strip's width; the zoom island is 36px.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: A row in the sidebar: the tree, Home and Recent, Open file…, and the Move to… picker.

tokens.name: nav-row-height
tokens.usage: Menu items.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Toolbar, zoom and footer buttons; ⋯ and New ▾ in Home's header row.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons in the chrome band (sidebar toggle, New diagram, More) and segment items.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Toolbar, edit bar and sidebar row icons (the chevron stays 14px); 15px in menus.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Home content width with the sidebar shown: 12 x 72 + 11 x 16.

tokens.name: content-max-wide
tokens.usage: Home content width with the sidebar hidden: 12 x 88 + 11 x 16.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns in the Home content grid.

tokens.name: grid-column
tokens.usage: One column of the regular grid.

tokens.name: grid-column-wide
tokens.usage: One column of the wide grid.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter between columns, and the gap between cards.

tokens.usage: Every size and space is a multiple of 4 (2 for hairline gaps).
